description: All locales and translations that are available in BYTM.

^[a-z]{2}-[A-Z]{2,}.description: Main locale code in the format "ll-CC" (language-COUNTRY).

name.description: Native name and country of the language, e.g. "Deutsch (Deutschland)".

nameEnglish.description: English name and country of the language, e.g. "German (Germany)".

userscriptDesc.description: Localized userscript description (the original is "description" in package.json).

authors.description: List of authors that contributed to the translation. Preferably a GitHub username or real name

altLocales.description: List of alternate BCP-47 locale codes that will be redirected to this locale, e.g. for the locale "de-DE" they would be: ["de", "de-AT", "de-BE", "de-CH", "de-LI", "de-LU"].

sentenceTerminatorNeutral.description: The character that ends a neutral, informative sentence, e.g. ".", "।" or "。".

sentenceTerminators.description: List of characters that end a sentence, e.g. ".", "!" or "?" in English.
